sloka: तमेवमुक्त्वा रुदतीं सीतां मायामयीं तदा।शितधारेण खड्गेन निजघानेन्द्रजित् स्वयम् ।। ६.८१.३१ ।।
transliteration: tamevamuktvā rudatīṁ sītāṁ māyāmayīṁ tadā।śitadhāreṇa khaḍgena nijaghānendrajit svayam ।। 6.81.31 ।।

translations.english: Indrajith killed that woman and said to Hanuman" see this Vaidehi, Rama's wife, cut up by my sword. Your exertion is useless now."
